By way of present appeal, challenge has been laid to an award dated 02.08.2001 0 passed by the learned Reference Court- Court cum-Addl.
Addl. District Judge, Gurdaspur.

Briefly stating, in the present case, some land owned by the appellant situated in the revenue estate of Village Tharra Jhikla Teeka Doong, Tehsil Dhar Kalan, Pathankot (erstwhile ile district Gurdaspur) came to be acquired vide notifications dated 23.06.1995 and 24.11.1995 issued under Sections 4 and 6 respectively of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (hereinafter referred to as 'the Act').
The acquisition was carried out for public purpose purpose, namely, for Hydel Channel of Shahpurkandi Dam Project Project..

At the time of acquisition, RFA-800 800-2002 (O&M) [2]
certain tain construction was already existing over the land in question regarding which award was passed by Land Acquisition Collector (for short 'the LAC') on 12.03.1998 granting compensation to the tune of Rs.1,00,210 1,00,210/- to the landowner(s).
Being aggrieved thereof,, the appellant landowner sought reference under Section 18 of the Act appellant-landowner which came to be dismissed.
Aggrieved of the decision dated 02.08.20 .2001, the present esent appeal has been preferred.

6. As per the records, the appellant appellant-landowner landowner was awarded sum of Rs.1,00,210/-
Rs. as compensation towards structure existing over the acquired land.

From the deposition of RW RW-2, Fakir Chand Goel, Extra Assistant Engineer, PWD, B&R B&R, it is clear that the award was passed on the basis of assessment made by the respondents- respondents authority.

Pertinently, the he valuation of house and other structures over the acquired land land needs to be carried out as per the current Common Schedule of Rates (CSR) as applicable to PWD Irrigation Branch.

7. On the other hand,, the valuation of the super structure has been proved on record as Rs.2,12,969 Rs.2,12,969.45/- by the appellant- appellant landowner through deposition of AW--2/Pawan Kumar;; the approved valuer (possessing Diploma of Civil Engineering) through Site plan (Ex.A-2)

Adopting the same, in order to balance the equities, the appellant appellant-landowner landowner is held entitled for award of compensation on the basis of average of the two RFA-800 800-2002 (O&M) [4] valuations i.e. one made by the LAC @ Rs.
Rs.1,00,210/-and and the other one which has been proved on record by the appellant appellant-landowner landowner through the expert valuer (AW-2) (AW ) @ Rs.
Rs.2,12,969.45/- which comes to Rs.1,56,589 1,56,589.72/- [(Rs.2,12,969.45+ + Rs.1,00,210)/2]
alongwith all other statutory benefits.
9.
In view of the aforesaid, the present appeal is disposed of.
